title.en: Haudenosaunee: council, clans and the Great Law
title.zh: 豪德诺索尼：议事会、氏族与大和平法

location.label: Onondaga homelands; representative council region

summary.en:
The Great Law of Peace organizes relationships among the Haudenosaunee nations through reason, responsibility and collective deliberation. The original five nations retained identities within the confederacy; Tuscarora participation later made the familiar Six Nations. Clan mothers and council chiefs held different responsibilities, so describing government only through male military leaders misses part of its structure.

The Smithsonian’s community-informed guide presents this history through oral tradition and continuing institutions. A single uncontested European-calendar founding year cannot be extracted from that tradition. This focus window permits comparison with neighboring political societies before and during colonial expansion; it does not date the birth or disappearance of Haudenosaunee governance. Later wartime divisions and treaties must be read alongside that continuity, rather than as proof that the confederacy ceased to exist.
summary.zh:
大和平法通过理性、责任与共同议事等原则，组织豪德诺索尼各族之间的关系。最初五族在联盟内保留自身身份；塔斯卡罗拉族后来加入，形成通常所称的六族。氏族母亲与议事首领承担不同职责，因此只写男性军事领袖会遗漏其政治结构的一部分。

史密森学会与社群合作编写的指南，通过口述传统和延续至今的制度介绍这段历史，不能由此推出一个没有争议的公历建盟年份。本条选择的时段用于比较殖民扩张前后的邻近政治社会，并不表示豪德诺索尼治理制度的起源或消失时间。后来的战争分歧和条约需要与这种延续性一起理解。

dateNote.en: Focus c.1400–1700, not a settled founding chronology or an end date for the confederacy.
dateNote.zh: 关注约1400—1700年；不是已确定的建盟年代，也不是联盟的终结日期。

title.en: Thule and Inuit: mobility across the Arctic
title.zh: 图勒与因纽特：穿越北极的流动

location.label: Canadian Arctic; representative regional point

summary.en:
Archaeologists use Thule for societies ancestral to many Inuit communities. Movement across Arctic North America depended on knowledge of sea ice, animals and seasonal travel. Skin boats, dogs and sleds linked marine hunting with movement on land; these were technologies embedded in family work and local environments, not simply equipment for a single migration.

Inuit accounts place both earlier peoples and Thule ancestors within their histories. Regional developments were not identical, and archaeological labels must not erase Inuit understandings of ancestry. Parks Canada describes changes in hunting and settlement as communities adapted to different coasts and resources. The dates shown are a broad window for expansion and regional differentiation. They do not imply that Inuit history ended in 1600 or that a moving border enclosed a uniform Arctic state.
summary.zh:
考古学家以“图勒”称呼许多因纽特社群的祖先社会。他们穿越北极北美，依赖对海冰、动物和季节交通的知识。皮船、狗与雪橇连接海洋狩猎和陆地移动；这些技术嵌入家庭劳动和地方环境，并非仅服务于一次迁徙的装备。

因纽特叙述把更早居民与图勒祖先共同纳入自身历史。各地发展并不相同，考古分类也不能取代因纽特对祖先的理解。加拿大公园局介绍了社群适应不同海岸与资源时狩猎和聚居方式的变化。本条年代是扩展及区域分化的大致观察窗口，不表示因纽特历史于1600年结束，更不代表北极曾由一条移动国界围成统一国家。

dateNote.en: Approximate regional focus c.1000–1600; archaeological classifications vary by locality.
dateNote.zh: 约1000—1600年的区域观察窗口；考古分类的年代因地点而异。

title.en: Ojibwe manoomin: food, water and responsibility
title.zh: 奥吉布瓦野米：食物、水域与责任

location.label: Leech Lake Ojibwe homelands; representative lake region

summary.en:
Manoomin, wild rice, is a food and a relationship with waters and seasonal cycles for Ojibwe communities. Harvesting requires knowledge of ripening seeds and movement through shallow lakes. Preparing and sharing the crop connects practical work with family teaching and cultural responsibilities. The Leech Lake examples presented by the Smithsonian foreground community voices rather than treating rice as an anonymous commodity.

Markets and people whose identity and obligations are tied to its habitat can understand the same resource differently. Loss of rice waters therefore threatens more than an annual harvest. This record connects food, environmental change and continuing community action. Its historical window is an editorial focus, not a dated origin of the practice. Nor does one Leech Lake example establish that every Anishinaabe community shares an identical local history.
summary.zh:
野米 manoomin 对奥吉布瓦社群既是食物，也是人与水域、季节循环的关系。采收需要了解种子何时成熟，以及如何穿行浅湖。加工与分享收成，把实际劳动同家庭教育和文化责任联系起来。史密森学会展示的利奇湖案例以社群成员的声音为中心，并不把野米当成没有来历的商品。

商业市场与身份、责任系于野米水域的人，可能对同一资源有不同理解。因此，生境丧失威胁的不止是一季收成。本条连接食物、环境变化与延续至今的社群行动。所选年代是编辑观察窗口，不是这一实践的起源时间；一个利奇湖案例也不能证明所有阿尼希纳贝社群拥有完全相同的地方史。

dateNote.en: Editorial focus 1700–2026; practice is older and continuing, not founded in 1700.
dateNote.zh: 编辑观察窗口为1700—2026年；实践更早存在且仍在延续，并非始于1700年。

title.en: Kwakwaka’wakw: potlatch suppression and return
title.zh: 夸夸嘉夸族：赠礼宴禁令与文物归还

location.label: Alert Bay / U’mista; representative community and cultural center

summary.en:
Potlatches make relationships, inherited responsibilities and public witnessing visible through speeches, gifts and ceremonial regalia. Canadian suppression targeted institutions rather than merely entertainment. After Dan Cranmer’s 1921 potlatch at Village Island, authorities arrested participants and forced families to surrender masks and other belongings under threat of imprisonment.

U’mista Cultural Centre recounts the confiscations from the perspective of communities whose property was taken. Decades of work to recover the collection eventually gave returned objects a home at Alert Bay. Repatriation belongs to the history of political authority, family rights and cultural transmission as well as museum display. This record distinguishes the Kwakwaka’wakw case from neighboring Northwest Coast traditions. The display window ends with U’mista’s opening, not completion of every return or the end of the potlatch.
summary.zh:
赠礼宴通过演说、礼物与仪式用具，使亲属关系、世袭责任和公众见证成为可见的制度。加拿大的压制针对这些制度，并不只是禁止娱乐。丹·克兰默于1921年在维利奇岛举行赠礼宴后，当局逮捕参与者，并以监禁相威胁，迫使家庭交出面具及其他物品。

乌米斯塔文化中心从被剥夺财产的社群立场叙述没收事件。数十年的追索，使部分文物回到阿勒特湾。归还因此既是博物馆史，也是政治权威、家庭权利和文化传承的历史。本条区分夸夸嘉夸族与邻近西北海岸各族的传统；窗口终于乌米斯塔开放之年，不表示所有归还工作完成或赠礼宴传统终结。

dateNote.en: Focus: ban era through U’mista’s 1980 opening. The 1884 amendment took effect in 1885; not the lifespan of the potlatch.
dateNote.zh: 关注禁令时代至1980年乌米斯塔开放。1884年修法于1885年生效；并非赠礼宴传统的存续年代。

title.en: Comanche networks: horses, bison and exchange
title.zh: 科曼奇网络：马匹、野牛与交换

location.label: Southern Plains; representative regional point

summary.en:
Comanche communities made horses central to mobility, bison hunting and regional exchange in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. Herds required grazing and care, while horses became commodities in networks involving skins, manufactured goods and captives. Trade, warfare and negotiation connected communities with New Mexico, Texas and other Indigenous societies. Areas appearing empty on a conventional state map could contain competing economic and political relationships.

An interdisciplinary study involving Indigenous researchers challenges older claims that horse cultures spread only after the Pueblo Revolt of 1680. European written observation is not the beginning of Indigenous practice. This record focuses on a documented Comanche regional phase without projecting one precise horse-arrival year onto all Plains peoples or treating Comanche history as ending with reservation confinement.
summary.zh:
十八、十九世纪，科曼奇社群把马匹用于交通、野牛狩猎与区域交换。养马需要牧草和照料，马也成为兽皮、制成品及俘虏交易网络中的商品。贸易、战争与协商，把社群同新墨西哥、得克萨斯及其他原住民社会联系起来。传统国家地图上看似空白的区域，可能存在彼此竞争的经济与政治关系。

一项有原住民研究者参与的跨学科研究，挑战了马文化仅在1680年普韦布洛起义后传播的旧说。欧洲人的书面观察不等于原住民实践的起点。本条聚焦有据可查的科曼奇区域阶段，不为全部平原民族指定单一马匹传入年份，也不以保留地禁锢作为科曼奇历史的终点。

dateNote.en: Focus c.1700–1875, not a founding or extinction interval; horse dispersal predates some colonial observations.
dateNote.zh: 约1700—1875年的窗口，并非建族或消失年代；马匹传播早于部分殖民观察记录。

title.en: Sitka, 1804: Kiks.ádi resistance to Russian expansion
title.zh: 1804年锡特卡：基克斯阿迪抵抗俄国扩张

location.label: Sitka National Historical Park; representative battlefield vicinity

summary.en:
The confrontation at Sitka was part of Russian commercial and colonial expansion into Tlingit homelands. Kiks.ádi defenders fought forces connected with the Russian-American Company, whose power rested on maritime access and the fur trade. Interpreting the encounter only as a step toward the later American purchase of Alaska makes Indigenous political decisions disappear from the account.

The park preserves the battlefield landscape alongside reminders of Russian settlement. These remains support a local history of resistance and subsequent colonial relationships, not a claim that Tlingit sovereignty simply transferred between outside empires. The point marks a particular confrontation, not the changing reach of Russian influence across Alaska. Tlingit communities and institutions continued after the fighting, and later agreements and commercial arrangements require their own dated evidence.
summary.zh:
锡特卡冲突属于俄国商业力量和殖民权力进入特林吉特家园的过程。基克斯阿迪守军抵抗与俄美公司有关的部队，后者的力量依靠海上交通和毛皮贸易。若只把这次相遇写成后来美国购买阿拉斯加的一步，原住民的政治选择就会从叙述中消失。

历史公园保留战场景观和俄国聚居遗迹，可用于理解当地的抵抗及后续殖民关系，不能由此声称特林吉特主权被两个外来帝国简单转交。点位表示一次冲突，而非俄国在阿拉斯加不断变化的影响范围。特林吉特社群与制度在战后继续存在，后来的协议与商业安排需要另行核实年代和证据。

dateNote.en: Battle year 1804; representative point, not a reconstructed battle line.
dateNote.zh: 战斗发生于1804年；点位为代表位置，不是复原战线。

title.en: Métis bison hunts: food, trade and collective rules
title.zh: 梅蒂斯野牛狩猎：食物、贸易与共同规则

location.label: Red River region; representative gathering point

summary.en:
Large Métis bison hunts joined households in seasonal work supplying meat, hides and provisions for exchange. Families could travel together for months, and safety, movement and hunting required collective organization. The hunts connected prairie environments to commercial demand from the fur trade while contributing to a distinct Métis social and political life.

The Indigenous Peoples Atlas places seasonal work within community lifeways. Reducing Métis identity to mixed ancestry loses the institutions, languages and shared experiences through which a people formed. This entry uses Red River as a reference for nineteenth-century hunting networks, without drawing a boundary around the whole Métis homeland. Later resistance over surveys and land transfer makes more sense when read against these existing practices of organization, trade and land use.
summary.zh:
大型梅蒂斯野牛狩猎把家庭聚集于季节性劳动，生产肉、兽皮和可供交换的给养。家庭可能共同旅行数月，安全、迁移与狩猎需要集体组织。狩猎连接草原环境与毛皮贸易的商业需求，也参与塑造独特的梅蒂斯社会与政治生活。

《加拿大原住民族地图集》将季节劳动置于社群生活之中。若把梅蒂斯身份仅归结为混合血统，就会遗漏这个民族形成过程中的制度、语言和共同经历。本条以红河作为十九世纪狩猎网络的参照，不绘制全部梅蒂斯家园的边界。了解已有组织、贸易和土地利用方式，才能理解后来的测量及土地转让争议。

dateNote.en: Focus c.1800–1870; seasonal practices and Métis history extend beyond this window.
dateNote.zh: 关注约1800—1870年；季节实践及梅蒂斯历史延续于窗口之外。

title.en: Red River, 1869–1870: negotiating Manitoba
title.zh: 1869—1870年红河：协商马尼托巴的建立

location.label: Upper Fort Garry / Red River; representative political center

summary.en:
Surveyors entering Red River without Métis consent encountered organized opposition in 1869. Canada’s acquisition of the Hudson’s Bay Company’s territorial claims did not settle the rights of people already living there. Métis political organization and a provisional government sought a negotiated basis for entry into Confederation, with land, language and local institutions at stake.

Negotiations contributed to the creation of Manitoba in 1870. The agreement did not eliminate later dispossession, disputes over land implementation or violence against Métis families. Reading the event only as the orderly expansion of a Canadian province obscures the conflict over whose consent mattered. Bison-hunting communities and river-lot occupation formed the social setting of the negotiations. Louis Riel’s subsequent exile and return belong to the unresolved history that followed provincial creation.
summary.zh:
1869年，测量员未获梅蒂斯人同意便进入红河地区，遭遇有组织的反对。加拿大取得哈德逊湾公司的领土主张，不等于解决当地既有居民的权利。梅蒂斯政治组织与临时政府要求协商加入联邦的条件，土地、语言和地方制度都是争议核心。

谈判促成1870年马尼托巴省建立，但未消除后来的土地剥夺、承诺实施争议或针对梅蒂斯家庭的暴力。只把此事写成加拿大省份的有序扩张，会掩盖谁的同意具有分量这一冲突。野牛狩猎社群和河岸长条地占有构成谈判的社会背景。路易·里尔后来的流亡与返回，属于建省后尚未解决的历史。

dateNote.en: Focus 1869–1870; negotiations did not resolve all subsequent land claims.
dateNote.zh: 聚焦1869—1870年；协商并未解决全部后续土地问题。

title.en: Fort Laramie: a treaty and its violation
title.zh: 拉勒米堡：条约与违约

location.label: Fort Laramie; representative treaty-negotiation site

summary.en:
The 1868 Fort Laramie treaty recorded obligations between the United States and signatory Lakota, Dakota and Arapaho representatives. It established the Great Sioux Reservation, including the Black Hills, while addressing hunting, settlement and federal promises. The document records a negotiated political relationship rather than an agreement that the land had previously been unoccupied.

The discovery of gold and arrival of miners helped drive a renewed assault on the settlement. Following military conflict, the United States took the Black Hills in 1877. Placing the agreement beside its violation shows why treaties cannot be reduced to dates when Indigenous nations supposedly surrendered everything. Archival treaty texts, supporting correspondence and Indigenous accounts illuminate different perspectives on consent, obligation and land. Later litigation and continuing political action extend the history beyond the territorial breach described here.
summary.zh:
1868年拉勒米堡条约记录美国与签署的拉科塔、达科塔及阿拉帕霍代表之间的义务，设立包括黑山在内的大苏族保留地，并涉及狩猎、定居及联邦承诺。这份文件记录协商形成的政治关系，而不是承认土地从前无人占用。

黄金发现与矿工涌入，推动对条约安排的新一轮破坏。军事冲突后，美国于1877年夺取黑山。把协议与违约并列，便能理解条约为何不能被简化为原住民族据称放弃一切的日期。条约原文、附属书信与原住民叙述，揭示对同意、义务及土地的不同理解。后来的诉讼与政治行动，使这段历史延续于本条所述的领土侵夺之后。

title.en: Diné Long Walk: captivity and return
title.zh: 迪内长途迁徙：囚禁与返回

location.label: Bosque Redondo / Fort Sumner; representative incarceration site

summary.en:
U.S. military campaigns forced thousands of Navajo, or Diné, people from their homelands to Bosque Redondo during the 1860s. The Long Walk was not one journey: groups followed different routes under coercion. Hunger, exhaustion, violence and family separation made movement itself part of the assault. Navajo oral histories preserve experiences that military summaries cannot convey alone.

The treaty of 1868 allowed return to part of the homeland after the confinement scheme failed. Returning did not restore an unchanged world: the treaty introduced obligations and restrictions as well as a route out of captivity. Removal, survival and negotiation are connected parts of this history. Accounts of women, children and elders make the consequences of military policy visible beyond the movements of armed forces.
summary.zh:
十九世纪六十年代，美国军事行动迫使数千纳瓦霍人——亦自称迪内——离开家园，前往博斯克雷东多。“长途迁徙”并非一条旅程：不同群体在胁迫下走过不同路线。饥饿、疲惫、暴力和家庭离散，使移动本身成为攻击的一部分。纳瓦霍口述史保存了军事摘要不能独自传达的经历。

禁锢计划失败后，1868年条约允许人们返回部分家园。但返回不等于原样恢复旧世界；条约既带来离开囚禁的途径，也规定义务和限制。驱逐、生存与协商是相互联系的历史环节。女性、儿童和长者的叙述，让读者看到军事行动之外政策对人的影响。

dateNote.en: Campaign/removal focus 1863–1868; several forced journeys, not one surveyed route.
dateNote.zh: 关注1863—1868年的军事驱逐；包含多次被迫行程，不是一条测绘路线。

title.en: Allotment: dividing Indigenous land
title.zh: 土地配给：分割原住民族土地

location.label: Washington, D.C.; representative legislative location

summary.en:
The Dawes Act of 1887 authorized the division of communally held reservation lands into individual allotments. Federal officials linked landholding to registration, citizenship and the expectation that Indigenous people would abandon collective institutions. Lands classified as surplus could pass to settlers. Administrative paperwork became a mechanism for changing ownership and weakening Native nations’ land bases.

Implementation differed among nations and developed through later legislation; the original act excluded several groups. The history therefore requires attention to specific reservations and records rather than a single map of instantaneous dispossession. The 1934 endpoint marks a federal policy shift under the Indian Reorganization Act, not the recovery of alienated lands. Allotment’s connections with boarding schools and later self-determination reveal a wider struggle over identity, resources and the authority to govern.
summary.zh:
1887年《道斯法》授权把保留地共同持有的土地划成个人份地。联邦官员将土地占有同登记、公民身份及原住民放弃集体制度的期待相连。被认定为“剩余”的土地可能转给定居者，行政文书因而成为改变所有权和削弱原住民族土地基础的机制。

各族实施情况不同，且随后续法律发展；原法排除若干群体。这段历史需要考察具体保留地与档案，不能用一张地图表现瞬间完成的剥夺。1934年标志《印第安人重组法》带来的联邦政策转向，不表示流失土地已经收回。配给与寄宿学校及后来自决运动的联系，揭示围绕身份、资源和治理权的更广泛斗争。

dateNote.zh: 从1887年《一般土地配给法》至1934年政策转向；实施因民族而异。

title.en: Canada’s Indian Act: classification and resistance
title.zh: 加拿大《印第安人法》：分类与抵抗

location.label: Ottawa; representative legislative location

summary.en:
The Indian Act consolidated colonial measures in 1876 and placed the federal government at the center of regulating status, reserve lands and band institutions. These classifications imposed administrative categories rather than neutrally describing every Indigenous people. They restricted political and cultural life, with unequal consequences for women who married men without registered status.

First Nations people resisted through community practice, organizing and legal challenges. Amendments in 1951 and 1985 changed parts of the system, including ceremonial restrictions and discriminatory registration rules, without erasing its effects. Women’s campaigns exposed how federal status categories could separate families from their communities. The distinction among First Nations, Inuit and Métis histories matters: their relationships with the state cannot all be compressed into identical provisions of this one statute.
summary.zh:
1876年《印第安人法》整合殖民措施，使联邦政府居于身份、保留地与部落机构管理的中心。这些类别是强加的行政分类，并非对全部原住民族的中性描述。它限制政治和文化生活；与无登记身份男子结婚的女性承受不平等待遇。

第一民族成员通过社群实践、组织行动及法律挑战抵抗控制。1951年与1985年的修法改变部分制度，包括仪式限制和歧视性登记规则，却未抹去其影响。妇女运动揭示联邦身份类别如何把家庭与社群分离。第一民族、因纽特人与梅蒂斯人的历史各有不同；他们同国家的关系，不能都压缩为同一部法律中的完全相同条文。

dateNote.en: Historical focus 1876–1985, not a claim that the Act ceased in 1985.
dateNote.zh: 历史观察窗口为1876—1985年，不表示该法于1985年失效。

title.en: Residential schools: separation, survival and testimony
title.zh: 寄宿学校：分离、生存与见证

location.label: Kamloops; representative school site, not the entire system

summary.en:
Church and government residential schools removed First Nations, Inuit and Métis children from families and communities in pursuit of assimilation. The National Centre for Truth and Reconciliation traces church-run schooling from 1831 and the expansion of federal funding in the 1880s. Punishment for Indigenous languages, inadequate conditions and abuse made schools instruments of cultural and personal harm.

Survivors and descendants preserved testimony and pressed for recognition, settlement and institutional accountability. The Truth and Reconciliation Commission characterized the system’s assault on distinct peoples and cultures as cultural genocide. Its findings cannot be replaced by a story of ordinary education. The 1996 endpoint follows a commonly used school chronology, while consequences extend beyond it. Each nation, institution and child experienced the system in particular ways that a national outline cannot fully convey.
summary.zh:
教会与政府寄宿学校以同化为目标，把第一民族、因纽特及梅蒂斯儿童从家庭和社群带走。国家真相与和解中心追溯1831年的教会学校，以及十九世纪八十年代联邦资助的扩张。禁止原住民语言、恶劣条件和虐待，使学校成为造成文化及个人伤害的工具。

幸存者与后代保存见证，要求承认伤害、达成和解安排并追究机构责任。真相与和解委员会以“文化种族灭绝”描述制度对独特民族和文化的攻击，不能用普通教育史取代其结论。本条采用常用年表中的1996年终点，影响却延续于此后。每个民族、机构和儿童经历的具体情况，都不能被一份全国概述完全涵盖。

title.en: Virginia: making hereditary racial slavery
title.zh: 弗吉尼亚：世袭种族奴隶制的形成

location.label: Jamestown / colonial Virginia; representative reference

summary.en:
Captive Africans reached England’s Virginia colony in 1619 after being seized from a Portuguese slave ship. Their arrival belonged to an Atlantic system of kidnapping, warfare and commerce already operating beyond Virginia. The colony’s later hereditary racial slavery was constructed through successive practices and laws rather than arriving as a complete legal code on one ship.

The 1640 lifetime sentence imposed on John Punch, the 1662 rule making a child’s status follow the mother, and the codification of slave laws in 1705 show changing mechanisms of coercion. These measures tied labour, reproduction and racial classification together. Free people of African descent also lived within the colony, so legal categories and individual histories must be distinguished. The case connects colonial labour needs with the systematic production of unequal rights across generations.
summary.zh:
1619年，被从葡萄牙贩奴船上劫走的非洲俘虏抵达英属弗吉尼亚。他们的到来属于在弗吉尼亚之外早已运作的大西洋绑架、战争与贸易体系。殖民地后来形成的世袭种族奴隶制，是一系列实践和法律逐步构造的结果，并非随一艘船抵达的完整法典。

1640年约翰·庞奇被判终身服役，1662年规定孩子身份随母，1705年奴隶法律被系统整理，这些节点展示胁迫机制的变化。措施把劳动、生育与种族分类连接起来。殖民地也有非洲裔自由人，因此法律类别必须与个人经历区分。这个案例把殖民劳动需求同跨代制造不平等权利的过程相连。

dateNote.en: 1619–1705 is a legal-development focus, not the beginning of slavery in the Americas.
dateNote.zh: 1619—1705年关注法律形成过程，并非美洲奴隶制的起点。

title.en: New France: fur trade through Indigenous alliances
title.zh: 新法兰西：原住民族联盟中的毛皮贸易

location.label: St Lawrence / Québec; representative trading gateway

summary.en:
French merchants could not obtain and move furs through North America without Indigenous producers, guides and intermediaries. Hunting, processing and transport drew on knowledge and labour that colonial traders did not independently possess. Alliances with Innu, Algonquin, Huron-Wendat and other nations therefore shaped commerce as well as military and diplomatic relationships.

The fur trade helped finance exploration, missions and settlement while creating demand for an itinerant workforce and inland posts. It also connected household work to merchants and overseas consumers. Indigenous communities participated according to their own interests in a changing and unequal environment; they were not simply background helpers in a European expansion story. Rivalries and alliances shifted over time. The eventual British conquest changed imperial administration without instantly ending the networks, knowledge or people on which trade depended.
summary.zh:
法国商人若没有原住民生产者、向导与中间人，就无法在北美获取和运输毛皮。狩猎、加工及交通依赖殖民商人并不独立掌握的知识与劳动。因此，同因努、阿尔冈昆、休伦—温达特等民族的联盟，既塑造商业，也影响军事和外交关系。

毛皮贸易资助探险、传教及聚居，并带来流动劳动力与内陆商站的需求，也把家庭劳动同商人和海外消费者连接起来。原住民社群在变化且不平等的环境中依自身利益参与，并非欧洲扩张故事的背景助手。竞争与联盟随时间改变。英国征服改变帝国行政，却没有瞬间终止贸易依赖的网络、知识或社群。

title.en: Metacom’s War: land, violence and Wampanoag survival
title.zh: 梅塔科姆战争：土地、暴力与万帕诺亚格人的延续

location.label: Mount Hope / southern New England; representative reference

summary.en:
Growing colonial settlement and demands on Native land strained relationships in seventeenth-century New England. Metacom, known to English colonists as King Philip, formed alliances with neighboring Native nations against English power. Fighting destroyed settlements and communities on both sides. English victories were followed by the killing, capture and sale into slavery of Native people.

The aftermath included further land loss and pressure to hide or change cultural practices. Yet Wampanoag communities survived, maintaining family relationships and livelihoods, including work in coastal fishing and whaling. Contemporary communities and language-reclamation work contradict accounts that end Native history with the war. This episode belongs beside earlier diplomacy and later Indigenous persistence. It also challenges the familiar holiday narrative that treats the 1621 harvest gathering as a lasting settlement of relations between colonists and Native nations.
summary.zh:
十七世纪新英格兰的殖民聚居扩大与土地索求，使双方关系日趋紧张。被英国殖民者称为“菲利普王”的梅塔科姆，同邻近原住民族结盟抵抗英国权力。战争摧毁双方的聚居点和社群；英国获胜后，原住民遭到杀害、俘获并被出售为奴。

战后土地继续流失，人们也承受隐藏或改变文化实践的压力。但万帕诺亚格社群延续下来，维系亲属关系与生计，包括海岸捕鱼及捕鲸。今日社群和语言复兴工作，反驳了把原住民历史终结于战争的叙述。这段历史应与更早的外交及后来的延续并列，也挑战把1621年收获聚会当作永久解决殖民者与原住民族关系的节庆故事。

dateNote.en: 1675–1676 refers to the main southern New England conflict; related northern fighting and consequences lasted longer.
dateNote.zh: 1675—1676年指新英格兰南部主要战争；北方相关战事及其后果延续更久。

title.en: Chinese exclusion: migration controlled by race
title.zh: 美国排华：以种族控制迁徙

location.label: San Francisco Chinatown; representative migrant community

summary.en:
The Chinese Exclusion Act of 1882 barred Chinese labour immigration and imposed documentary requirements that affected people already living in the United States. Restrictions on naturalization and re-entry made travel, work and family reunification precarious. The legislation differentiated people by race and class, while bureaucratic investigation extended its effects beyond the text of a single prohibition.

Later renewals and amendments maintained exclusion until repeal in 1943, when restrictive immigration rules still remained. Chinese residents built businesses, associations and families while challenging exclusion through paperwork and litigation. Their experiences connect the railroad and mining economies to the growth of a federal immigration apparatus. Archival case files preserve both official suspicion and traces of people’s efforts to establish identity, kinship and a right to enter or return.
summary.zh:
1882年《排华法案》禁止华工移民，并设置影响既有美国居民的文件要求。入籍与重新入境限制，使旅行、工作和家庭团聚变得不稳定。法律以种族和阶级区分人群，而行政调查使影响超出单一禁令的文字。

后来的续期与修法维持排斥制度，直至1943年废除，但限制性移民规则仍然存在。华人居民建立企业、社团与家庭，并通过文件和诉讼挑战排斥。他们的经历把铁路、矿业经济同联邦移民管理体系的成长联系起来。个案档案既保留官员的怀疑，也留下人们努力证明身份、亲属关系及入境或返回权利的痕迹。

dateNote.en: 1882 statute to 1943 repeal; repeal did not abolish all immigration restrictions.
dateNote.zh: 从1882年立法至1943年废除；废除并未消除全部移民限制。

title.en: Japanese American incarceration and redress
title.zh: 日裔美国人的拘禁与补偿

location.label: Manzanar; representative incarceration site

summary.en:
Executive Order 9066 authorized military exclusion in 1942. Although it did not name an ethnic group, implementation on the West Coast targeted people of Japanese ancestry, including U.S. citizens. Families were forced to leave homes, businesses and communities for confinement under government control. Official language about relocation obscured the loss of liberty and property.

People responded in different ways, including legal challenges, community organization and military service; those choices cannot be reduced to a single measure of loyalty. Later investigation concluded that the policy was not justified by military necessity. The 1988 Civil Liberties Act acknowledged wrongdoing and provided redress to eligible survivors. The history links wartime executive power to racial classification and the decades of organizing required for public recognition, rather than treating release from confinement as the end of its consequences.
summary.zh:
1942年第9066号行政命令授权军事排除。命令虽然未点名族群，西海岸的实施却针对日本血统者，包括美国公民。家庭被迫离开住宅、企业和社群，进入政府控制的拘禁设施。官方所谓“迁移”的用语，掩盖自由与财产的丧失。

人们通过法律挑战、社群组织、服兵役等不同方式回应，不能用单一忠诚标准评价这些选择。后来的调查认定，该政策并非出于军事必要。1988年《公民自由法》承认错误，并向符合条件的幸存者提供补偿。这段历史把战时行政权、种族分类及争取公开承认的数十年组织工作相连，不能以获释作为后果的终点。

title.en: Winnipeg, 1919: workers organize a general strike
title.zh: 1919年温尼伯：工人组织总罢工

location.label: Winnipeg; representative strike center

summary.en:
Inflation, insecure employment and demands for collective bargaining shaped the Winnipeg General Strike of 1919. Building and metal workers’ disputes widened in May as union and non-union workers stopped work across the city. Essential services, employers and public authorities became part of a contest over who could organize production and negotiate working conditions after the First World War.

The strike drew sympathy actions elsewhere in Canada and hostility from opponents who portrayed labour organizing as a threat to order. Police action and the violence remembered as Bloody Saturday marked its suppression. The immediate defeat did not eliminate demands for representation and labour rights. Museum objects and contemporary records reveal both the coercive response and the participation of ordinary workers, allowing the event to be understood as social history rather than only a clash among prominent political leaders.
summary.zh:
通货膨胀、就业不稳与集体谈判要求，塑造1919年温尼伯总罢工。五月，建筑和金属工人的争议扩大，工会与非工会工人共同停工。基本服务、雇主与公共当局都卷入一场斗争，争论第一次世界大战后谁能组织生产、协商劳动条件。

罢工在加拿大其他地区引起声援，反对者则把工人组织描绘成秩序威胁。警察行动及被称为“血腥星期六”的暴力，标志镇压过程。眼前的失败没有消除代表权和劳工权利诉求。博物馆物品与同时代档案既揭示强制反应，也显示普通工人的参与，使事件成为社会史，而不只是著名政治领袖之间的冲突。

title.en: Québec’s Quiet Revolution: institutions and identity
title.zh: 魁北克静悄悄革命：制度与身份

location.label: Québec City; representative provincial institutional center

summary.en:
The Quiet Revolution names a period of institutional and social change in Québec during the 1960s. Expanding provincial responsibilities and a changing relationship between public institutions and religious authority altered education, services and political debate. Questions about language, economic power and the place of French-speaking society in Canada became linked to competing visions of Québec’s future.

Change within the province also reshaped federal politics. The Royal Commission on Bilingualism and Biculturalism and the 1969 Official Languages Act belonged to a wider response to language and representation. Support for sovereignty developed alongside federalist reform rather than replacing every other position. The term revolution therefore refers to a sustained transformation of institutions and expectations, not a single uprising or an agreed moment when all Quebecers adopted one national project.
summary.zh:
“静悄悄革命”指魁北克二十世纪六十年代的制度与社会变革。省级职责扩大，公共机构与宗教权威的关系改变，教育、服务和政治讨论随之变化。语言、经济权力及法语社会在加拿大的位置，同对魁北克未来的不同设想联系起来。

省内变化也重塑联邦政治。双语与双文化皇家委员会，以及1969年《官方语言法》，属于对语言和代表问题的更广泛回应。主权诉求与联邦主义改革并行发展，而非取代一切其他立场。因此，“革命”指制度和期待的持续转变，不是一次起义，也不是所有魁北克人一致接受某个民族方案的时刻。

title.en: 1982: patriation, a Charter and unresolved agreement
title.zh: 1982年：宪法回归、宪章与未竟共识

location.label: Ottawa; representative constitutional proclamation site

summary.en:
In 1982 Canada gained its own constitutional amendment arrangements through patriation, and the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms became part of the constitutional text. The Charter addressed fundamental freedoms and other rights within a framework of limits, legislative powers and judicial interpretation. Constitutional reform also recognized existing Aboriginal and treaty rights in a separate provision.

The achievement was accompanied by unresolved political disagreement: Québec’s government did not consent to the 1982 settlement. Formal constitutional change therefore did not mean a shared national understanding of every issue. Later debates over language, Indigenous rights and the division of powers continued to test the arrangement. The event connects nineteenth-century federation to modern struggles over citizenship and collective identity without treating the constitutional document as a complete account of lived equality.
summary.zh:
1982年，加拿大通过宪法回归取得自己的修宪安排，《加拿大权利与自由宪章》成为宪法文本的一部分。宪章在权利限制、立法权与司法解释的框架内规定基本自由及其他权利。宪制改革也在另一条文中承认既有原住民族及条约权利。

这一成就伴随未解决的政治分歧：魁北克政府没有同意1982年的安排。因此，正式宪制变化不等于对所有问题形成全国共同理解。后来的语言、原住民族权利和权力分配争论继续检验该安排。这一事件把十九世纪联邦建立同现代公民身份及集体认同之争相连，但宪法文本不能完全代表实际生活中的平等。

title.en: Great Migration: moving against Jim Crow
title.zh: 非裔美国人大迁徙：离开吉姆·克劳秩序

location.label: Chicago; representative destination, not a single migration route

summary.en:
Approximately six million Black Americans moved from the South to northern, midwestern and western states during the Great Migration. Racial violence, segregation and limited opportunities pushed people to leave, while industrial demand and family networks helped shape destinations. The movements unfolded in phases associated with both world wars rather than as one organized journey.

Migrants transformed neighbourhoods, churches, political organizations and cultural life in cities such as Chicago, Detroit and New York. They also encountered employment discrimination, housing restrictions and racial attacks. Leaving the South did not end inequality, but it changed the geography of Black political power and community-building. Archival employment, housing and family records permit connections between household decisions and national economic change. A destination pin represents one part of these dispersed histories, not the origin or route of every migrant.
summary.zh:
大迁徙期间，约六百万美国黑人从南部前往北部、中西部及西部州。种族暴力、隔离和机会不足推动人们离开，工业需求及家庭网络则影响目的地。迁移分为同两次世界大战有关的阶段，并非一次有组织的统一旅程。

移民改变芝加哥、底特律和纽约等城市的街区、教会、政治组织及文化生活，也遭遇就业歧视、住房限制与种族攻击。离开南部没有终结不平等，却改变黑人政治力量和社群建设的地理分布。就业、住房及家庭档案，使家庭决定能够同全国经济变化相联系。目的地地图点仅表示这些分散历史的一部分，不是每位移民的起点或路线。

title.en: Stonewall: resisting police raids
title.zh: 石墙事件：抵抗警察突袭

location.label: Stonewall Inn / Christopher Park; representative protest area

summary.en:
A police raid on the Stonewall Inn in June 1969 met resistance from patrons and people in the surrounding streets. Raids and public humiliation formed part of the policing of sexual and gender nonconformity. The demonstrations continued over several nights, turning one neighbourhood confrontation into a reference point for organizing beyond Greenwich Village.

Stonewall did not begin the struggle for sexual and gender rights; earlier organizations and acts of resistance had already built networks and arguments. Its significance lies in the momentum, public identification and new forms of activism associated with the uprising. Participants were diverse, and later commemorations can obscure disagreements about leadership and whose experiences receive recognition. Reading the landscape alongside accounts of policing shows how access to public space and social gathering became a political question.
summary.zh:
1969年6月，警察突袭石墙酒吧，遭到顾客及周边街道人群的抵抗。突袭和公开羞辱，是警察控制性取向及性别不合规范者的方式之一。示威持续数夜，使一次街区冲突成为格林尼治村之外组织行动的参照。

石墙事件不是性与性别权利斗争的起点；此前的组织和抵抗早已建立网络及论述。它的重要性在于起义带来的动员势头、公开认同与新行动形式。参与者多样，后来的纪念可能掩盖对领导地位和哪些经历获得承认的分歧。把场所景观与警察执法叙述并读，可见使用公共空间和社交聚会如何成为政治问题。

title.en: Alcatraz, 1969–1971: Indians of All Tribes
title.zh: 1969—1971年恶魔岛：各族原住民的占领

location.label: Alcatraz Island; occupation site

summary.en:
Indigenous activists occupied the former federal prison island of Alcatraz from November 1969 to June 1971. Indians of All Tribes brought together people from different nations, including students and communities reshaped by federal urban relocation policies. The occupation protested the taking of Native lands and the effort to dissolve distinct cultures and political relationships.

The island became a place for public statements, collective living and demands for Indigenous control of education and cultural institutions. Activists used the location’s federal status and prison history to challenge assumptions about who could determine land use. Difficult living conditions and internal disagreements formed part of the occupation alongside solidarity and publicity. Its impact extended beyond the island, contributing to a wider movement for sovereignty and self-determination rather than creating one new nation-state on San Francisco Bay.
summary.zh:
1969年11月至1971年6月，原住民行动者占领曾为联邦监狱的恶魔岛。“各族原住民”团体汇集不同民族成员，包括学生及受联邦城市迁移政策影响的社群。占领抗议夺取原住民土地，以及瓦解独特文化和政治关系的政策。

岛上成为公开声明、共同生活及要求原住民掌握教育和文化机构的场所。行动者利用岛屿的联邦地位和监狱历史，挑战谁能决定土地用途的假设。恶劣生活条件和内部争论，与团结和公众关注同时存在。其影响超出岛屿，参与推动更广泛的主权和自决运动，而非在旧金山湾建立一个新的民族国家。

title.en: Delgamuukw: oral histories enter the courtroom
title.zh: 德尔加穆克案：口述史进入法庭

location.label: Gitxsan / Wet’suwet’en homelands; representative regional point

summary.en:
The Delgamuukw litigation brought Gitxsan and Wet’suwet’en claims and oral histories before Canadian courts. In its 1997 judgment, the Supreme Court addressed Aboriginal title and the treatment of oral evidence. Histories transmitted through community institutions could not simply be dismissed because they differed from the written records familiar to Canadian courts.

The judgment did not itself settle ownership of every claimed territory; a new trial was ordered. Its importance includes the way legal institutions confronted knowledge systems they had marginalized. Scholarly analysis also asks whether later courts have fulfilled that promise when evaluating oral histories. The case connects land, law and historical method: deciding which forms of evidence count affects whose account of the past can influence present institutions. Indigenous histories retain meanings and responsibilities beyond their use as evidence in litigation.
summary.zh:
德尔加穆克诉讼把吉特克桑和韦特苏韦特恩人的土地诉求与口述史带入加拿大法院。最高法院在1997年判决中讨论原住民族土地权及口述证据的处理。社群制度传承的历史，不能仅因不同于法院熟悉的书面记录而被排除。

判决并未直接确定全部诉求土地的所有权，而是要求重新审理。其重要性也在于法律机构如何面对自己长期边缘化的知识体系。学术研究还追问，后来的法院评估口述史时是否实现这一承诺。此案把土地、法律与史学方法相连：什么证据被认可，会影响谁的历史叙述能够作用于制度。原住民族历史的意义与责任，也超出它作为诉讼证据的用途。

title.en: The New Deal: relief, work and federal responsibility
title.zh: 新政：救济、工作与联邦责任

location.label: Washington, D.C.; representative federal program center

summary.en:
The New Deal responded to the Great Depression with relief, public employment and institutional reform. Federal agencies supported work on infrastructure, conservation and public services while attempting to stabilize a damaged economy. Programs such as the Civilian Conservation Corps and Works Progress Administration connected national policy to labour performed in communities across the country.

A second phase in 1935 strengthened collective bargaining and established Social Security. These changes expanded expectations of federal responsibility, but benefits and access were unequal and recovery remained contested. Administrative records, workers’ accounts and public artworks reveal different aspects of the same programs. The New Deal was a collection of experiments, conflicts and compromises rather than one measure that ended the Depression. Its employment and welfare institutions belong beside migration, racial inequality and the changing organization of industrial work.
summary.zh:
新政以救济、公共就业和制度改革回应大萧条。联邦机构支持基础设施、环境保护及公共服务劳动，并试图稳定受损经济。民间资源保护队和公共事业振兴署等项目，把全国政策同各地社群中的实际劳动联系起来。

1935年的第二阶段强化集体谈判并建立社会保障，扩大了公众对联邦责任的期待，但受益和参与并不平等，经济复苏也存在争议。行政档案、工人叙述与公共艺术呈现同一项目的不同侧面。新政是一系列试验、冲突和妥协，并非一项终结萧条的单独措施。其就业及福利制度应同迁徙、种族不平等和工业劳动组织变化一起理解。

title.en: Louis Riel · Negotiating Métis political rights
title.zh: 路易·里尔 · 协商梅蒂斯政治权利

location.label: Red River / Saint-Boniface; representative political setting

summary.en:
Louis Riel became a spokesman for Métis resistance when Canadian expansion threatened Red River’s landholding and political arrangements. He headed a provisional government after the occupation of Upper Fort Garry in 1869. Negotiations helped establish Manitoba in 1870, but the settlement did not prevent conflict, displacement or the failure to secure all promised protections.

Riel’s career also involved the provisional government’s execution of Thomas Scott, exile in the United States and a return to the North-West in 1884. In 1885 he led resistance connected with Métis land grievances and was convicted and executed for treason. Different communities have interpreted his actions differently. His life joins constitutional negotiation to the social history of a people whose institutions existed before Canada’s claim to administer their homeland.
summary.zh:
加拿大扩张威胁红河地区的土地与政治安排时，路易·里尔成为梅蒂斯抵抗的发言人。1869年上加里堡被占后，他领导临时政府。协商促成1870年马尼托巴省建立，但没有阻止冲突、迁离或承诺保护未能落实。

他的生涯还涉及临时政府处决托马斯·斯科特、流亡美国，以及1884年返回西北地区。1885年，他领导与梅蒂斯土地不满有关的抵抗，随后以叛国罪被定罪并处决。不同社群对其行动有不同解释。他的一生把宪制协商同梅蒂斯社会史相连：加拿大提出行政主张之前，这个民族已拥有自己的制度。

title.en: Wilma Mankiller · Community work and Cherokee government
title.zh: 威尔玛·曼基勒 · 社群劳动与切罗基治理

location.label: Tahlequah / Cherokee Nation; representative governmental setting

summary.en:
Wilma Mankiller linked Cherokee self-government to practical improvements in community life. After returning to Oklahoma, she worked on development projects, including the Bell water project, in which residents organized labour to bring running water to their community. The project expressed her belief that people could build collective capacity rather than wait for outsiders to solve every problem.

She became Principal Chief of the Cherokee Nation in 1985 and won election in 1987, serving until 1995. Her administration worked on education, housing, health and stronger tribal institutions. Holding office also required negotiation with federal agencies and attention to the powers of a sovereign nation. Her story connects women’s leadership with everyday infrastructure and Indigenous political authority; it is not simply the exceptional rise of one individual apart from community organizing.
summary.zh:
威尔玛·曼基勒把切罗基自治同社群生活的实际改善相连。返回俄克拉何马后，她从事发展项目，包括贝尔供水工程：居民组织劳动，为社群引入自来水。该项目体现她的信念，即人们能够建立集体能力，而非等待外来者解决所有问题。

她于1985年出任切罗基民族首席酋长，1987年赢得选举，任职至1995年。其政府推进教育、住房、健康和部落机构建设。任职也需要同联邦机构协商，并关注主权民族的权力。她的故事连接女性领导、日常基础设施与原住民族政治权威，而不是一个脱离社群组织工作的个人成功传奇。

title.en: Zitkála-Šá · Writing, music and Indigenous rights
title.zh: 齐特卡拉莎 · 写作、音乐与原住民族权利

location.label: Washington, D.C.; representative organizing setting

summary.en:
Zitkála-Šá, also known as Gertrude Simmons Bonnin, was a Yankton Dakota writer, musician, teacher and organizer. Her accounts of boarding-school experience challenged the idea that assimilation was a harmless gift of education. Literary work and music became ways to address audiences who often expected Native people to disappear into a romanticized past.

She edited American Indian Magazine and argued for cultural identity, political representation and voting rights. In 1926 she and her husband founded the National Council of American Indians. Citizenship legislation did not automatically remove state barriers to voting, so organizing continued after 1924. Her career connected artistic work to investigation of exploitation and the demand for public voice. It also shows that Indigenous activists could criticize assimilation while supporting citizenship, a position that cannot be reduced to a single opposition between tradition and modernity.
summary.zh:
齐特卡拉莎亦名格特鲁德·西蒙斯·邦宁，是扬克顿达科塔作家、音乐家、教师与组织者。她对寄宿学校经历的叙述，挑战把同化视为无害教育恩赐的观念。文学和音乐成为面向公众发言的方式，而许多听众原本期待原住民只存在于浪漫化的过去。

她编辑《美国印第安人杂志》，争取文化身份、政治代表与投票权。1926年，她与丈夫成立美国印第安人全国委员会。公民身份立法没有自动消除州一级的投票障碍，因此1924年后仍需组织行动。她的生涯把艺术、揭露剥削和公共发声相连，也表明原住民行动者可以同时批评同化、支持公民身份，不能用传统与现代的单一对立概括。

title.en: Mary Two-Axe Earley · Challenging discriminatory status rules
title.zh: 玛丽·双斧·厄利 · 挑战歧视性身份规则

location.label: Kahnawà:ke; representative home and organizing community

summary.en:
Mary Two-Axe Earley, a Kanien’kehá:ka woman from Kahnawà:ke, challenged rules that removed registered Indian status from First Nations women who married men without status. The same system treated men differently. Classification could determine whether women and their children could reside, hold property or be buried in their own communities, making discrimination a matter of family and daily life.

Her work built a network of allies over decades, despite opposition both within government and among some community leaders. Parliament’s 1985 amendments restored status to many women and children, though they did not end every dispute about registration and belonging. Filmmaker Courtney Montour later drew on archival recordings and community relationships to document her struggle. Earley’s life connects women’s organizing to the tension between imposed federal categories and Indigenous community relationships.
summary.zh:
来自卡纳瓦克的卡尼恩凯哈卡族女性玛丽·双斧·厄利，挑战第一民族女性嫁给无登记身份男子便被取消身份的规则。同一制度对男性作不同处理。行政分类可能决定女性及子女能否在自己的社群居住、拥有财产或安葬，使歧视直接影响家庭与日常生活。

她用数十年建立盟友网络，面对政府及部分社群领袖的反对。1985年议会修法恢复许多女性与儿童的身份，但没有终结全部登记和归属争论。电影人考特尼·蒙图尔后来利用档案录音与社群关系记录这场斗争。厄利的一生把女性组织行动，同联邦强加类别和原住民社群关系之间的张力相连。

title.en: Frederick Douglass · Freedom through print and speech
title.zh: 弗雷德里克·道格拉斯 · 印刷与演说中的自由

location.label: Rochester; representative newspaper and organizing setting

summary.en:
Frederick Douglass escaped slavery in 1838 with assistance from Anna Murray, whom he subsequently married. Literacy, public speaking and an expanding abolitionist network shaped his political career. His 1845 autobiography named people and places from his enslavement, answering doubters while increasing the danger that he could be recaptured.

After a British and Irish speaking tour, he returned legally free and established a newspaper in Rochester. The North Star joined personal testimony to an independent Black public voice. During the Civil War he argued for emancipation and fair treatment of Black soldiers; afterwards citizenship and voting rights remained central concerns. Douglass also supported women’s suffrage while disagreeing with allies over strategy. His career makes freedom an ongoing struggle over institutions and representation, not merely a moment of escape.
summary.zh:
弗雷德里克·道格拉斯于1838年在安娜·默里的帮助下逃离奴役，后来与她结婚。识字、公共演说和扩大的废奴网络塑造他的政治生涯。1845年自传写出受奴役时的人名与地点，回应质疑，也增加被重新捕获的危险。

在英国与爱尔兰巡回演讲后，他以合法自由身份返回，在罗切斯特办报。《北极星报》把个人见证同独立的黑人公共声音连接起来。内战期间，他争取解放及黑人士兵的公平待遇；此后，公民身份和投票权仍是核心关切。他也支持女性选举权，同时与盟友在策略上争论。他的生涯表明，自由是围绕制度和代表权持续的斗争，而不只是逃离奴役的一刻。

title.en: Ida B. Wells · Investigating racial violence
title.zh: 艾达·B·威尔斯 · 调查种族暴力

location.label: Chicago; representative organizing and publishing setting

summary.en:
Ida B. Wells used journalism to challenge the excuses offered for lynching. After the 1892 murder of her friend Thomas Moss and two other Black businessmen in Memphis, she investigated the relationship between racial terror, competition and official complicity. A mob destroyed her newspaper office, but forced departure did not end her work.

Southern Horrors and A Red Record brought cases and statistics to a wider public. Wells lectured abroad, organized in Chicago and connected protection from violence to economic and political rights. She challenged racism within the women’s suffrage movement and helped build the Alpha Suffrage Club. Her investigations show how evidence could be assembled against an official narrative sustained by intimidation. Her organizing also placed working-class Black communities and women within a civil-rights history often told through later national campaigns.
summary.zh:
艾达·B·威尔斯运用新闻调查，挑战为私刑辩护的借口。1892年，她的朋友托马斯·莫斯及另外两名孟菲斯黑人商人被杀后，她追查种族恐怖、商业竞争和官方纵容之间的关系。暴民摧毁报社，但被迫离开没有终止她的工作。

《南方恐怖》与《红色记录》把个案和统计带给更广泛公众。威尔斯赴海外演讲、在芝加哥组织行动，把免受暴力同经济及政治权利相连。她挑战妇女选举权运动中的种族歧视，并参与建立阿尔法选举权俱乐部。她的调查展示如何搜集证据，反驳以恐吓维持的官方叙述；组织工作也把黑人劳动社群和女性，纳入常由后来全国运动主导的民权史。

title.en: Viola Desmond · Challenging segregation in Canada
title.zh: 维奥拉·戴斯蒙德 · 挑战加拿大种族隔离

location.label: New Glasgow / Roseland Theatre; representative challenge site

summary.en:
Viola Desmond was a Black Nova Scotian businesswoman whose work in beauty culture created opportunities in a society that restricted Black women’s access to training and services. In November 1946 she refused to leave a main-floor seat at New Glasgow’s segregated Roseland Theatre. Police removed and jailed her, and the authorities used a tax-related charge rather than acknowledging the racial policy.

Supported by family and community allies, she challenged the conviction unsuccessfully. Her action was part of a longer African Nova Scotian struggle; Carrie Best had already resisted the same theatre’s segregation. Desmond’s case attracted public attention and contributed to organizing for equality. Her posthumous pardon in 2010 acknowledged an injustice her lifetime legal efforts had failed to overturn.
summary.zh:
维奥拉·戴斯蒙德是非裔新斯科舍女企业家。黑人女性获得培训和服务受限时，她的美容事业创造了机会。1946年11月，她在新格拉斯哥实行种族隔离的罗斯兰剧院，拒绝离开一层座位。警察将她拖走并关押，当局用税务指控掩盖种族政策。

在家人与社群盟友支持下，她挑战定罪但未成功。这属于非裔新斯科舍人更长久的斗争；凯莉·贝斯特此前已抵抗同一剧院的隔离。戴斯蒙德的案件引发公众注意，参与推动平等运动。2010年的身后赦免，承认了她在世时法律努力未能纠正的不公。

title.en: Rachel Carson · Making ecological relationships public
title.zh: 蕾切尔·卡森 · 让生态关系进入公共讨论

location.label: Silver Spring; representative writing setting

summary.en:
Rachel Carson combined work as a marine biologist with writing for a broad public. At the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service she prepared and edited publications that explained wildlife and ecological relationships. The success of The Sea Around Us in 1951 allowed her to devote more time to independent writing.

Silent Spring, published in 1962, assembled research on the effects of pesticide use across living systems. Carson worked with other scientists and researchers, making the book a synthesis of collective evidence as well as an individual literary achievement. Industry opposition and public debate made questions about environmental responsibility matters of political authority. Her work helped enlarge the audience for ecological thinking. It did not call for the simple rejection of all science or all pest control; it asked how evidence about harm should change decisions affecting shared environments.
summary.zh:
蕾切尔·卡森把海洋生物学工作同面向大众的写作结合。在美国鱼类及野生动物管理局，她撰写和编辑解释野生动物与生态关系的出版物。1951年《我们周围的海洋》成功后，她得以投入更多时间独立写作。

1962年出版的《寂静的春天》，汇集农药使用影响生命系统的研究。卡森与其他科学家和研究者合作，因此这本书既是个人文学成就，也是集体证据的综合。行业反对与公众辩论，使环境责任成为政治权威问题。她的工作扩大生态思维的公众范围，并非主张简单拒绝全部科学或害虫防治，而是追问危害证据应如何改变影响共同环境的决定。

dateNote.zh: 生卒年1907—1964；出版年份同后来的政策变化区分。

title.en: Taíno Caribbean societies: farming, authority and survival
title.zh: 泰诺加勒比社会：农耕、权威与延续

location.label: Hispaniola; representative island reference, not a single Taíno state

summary.en:
Caribbean societies grouped under the name Taíno developed island and inter-island relationships before European invasion. On Hispaniola, hereditary chiefs and subordinate leaders organized political relationships within several chiefdoms. Farming, fishing, craft production and exchange supported communities whose authority and ritual life cannot be understood through European descriptions alone.

The arrival of Spanish colonizers brought violence, forced labour, disease and upheaval. Colonial accounts later helped sustain the false impression that Native Caribbean peoples vanished. Smithsonian work with present-day descendants instead traces survival, cultural inheritance and movements asserting Indigenous identity. The label Taíno is useful but does not turn every island community into one uniform people or state. Archaeological evidence, colonial documents and descendant perspectives offer different kinds of information about the past and must be read together.
summary.zh:
欧洲入侵前，被统称为泰诺的加勒比社会已经形成岛内及跨岛联系。在伊斯帕尼奥拉，世袭首领与下级领袖，在多个酋邦内组织政治关系。农耕、捕鱼、工艺和交换支持社群，不能只依欧洲描述理解其权威与仪式生活。

西班牙殖民者到来带来暴力、强迫劳动、疾病与剧变。殖民记载后来又助长原住民已经消失的错误印象。史密森学会与今日后裔合作，追踪延续、文化传承及主张原住民身份的运动。“泰诺”是有用标签，却不能把各岛社群变成统一民族或国家。考古、殖民文献和后裔立场提供不同性质的历史信息，需要结合阅读。

dateNote.en: Focus c.1200–1500 follows a late pre-contact/encounter window; 1500 is not an extinction date.
dateNote.zh: 关注约1200—1500年的接触前后阶段；1500年不是消失日期。

title.en: Classic Maya: many royal cities, no single empire
title.zh: 古典期玛雅：多个王城而非单一帝国

location.label: Maya lowlands; representative regional reference

summary.en:
Classic-period Maya rulers governed competing cities connected by alliances, warfare, diplomacy and shared forms of royal display. Tikal, Calakmul, Palenque and Copán were not successive capitals of one empire. Kings and queens commissioned carved monuments and works in precious materials that linked political histories to divine authority and calendrical events.

Hieroglyphic inscriptions name individuals and record claims about ancestry, victories and ceremonies. They must be interpreted as commissioned statements rather than impartial descriptions of entire populations. Artists, farmers and other workers made the royal landscapes possible, while local histories followed different trajectories. The decline of several southern courts near the end of the Classic period was not the disappearance of Maya peoples. Northern centers and later communities continued, making a single shaded “Maya Empire” a misleading replacement for the evidence of political diversity.
summary.zh:
古典期玛雅统治者治理彼此竞争的城市，通过联盟、战争、外交及共有的王权展示形式相连。蒂卡尔、卡拉克穆尔、帕伦克与科潘，并非同一帝国先后更替的首都。国王和女王委托制作石刻及贵重材料作品，把政治史同神圣权威和历法事件联系起来。

象形文字铭文记录人名，以及祖先、胜利和仪式的主张，应视为受委托的陈述，而非全体人口的中立描述。艺术家、农民和其他劳动者使王城景观成为可能，各地也有不同发展轨迹。古典期末若干南方宫廷衰落，不等于玛雅民族消失。北方中心和后来的社群继续存在，用一块“玛雅帝国”色面取代这种政治多样性会造成误导。

dateNote.en: Conventional Classic period c.250–900 CE; regional chronologies and political trajectories differ.
dateNote.zh: 传统古典期约为公元250—900年；各地区分期与政治轨迹不同。

title.en: Maya continuity: languages, communities and knowledge
title.zh: 玛雅的延续：语言、社群与知识

location.label: Guatemalan highlands; representative community region

summary.en:
Maya history continues beyond ancient temples and the Spanish conquest. Communities speaking distinct Maya languages have maintained and changed farming practices, ceremonies, family institutions and forms of knowledge under colonial and national governments. The diversity of languages and local experiences makes “the Maya” a connected cultural world rather than a population that can be assigned one medieval ending.

Books such as the Popol Vuh preserve particular K’iche’ accounts, while contemporary oral and written work adds perspectives that archaeological monuments alone cannot supply. Community efforts to teach languages and assert political rights are part of the same historical field as earlier royal inscriptions, though they are not identical institutions. Rigoberta Menchú’s public advocacy offers one connection to modern histories of land, violence and representation. Continuity includes adaptation and disagreement, not a culture frozen unchanged from antiquity.
summary.zh:
玛雅历史延续于古代神庙和西班牙征服之后。讲不同玛雅语言的社群，在殖民与民族国家统治下，维持并改变农耕、仪式、家庭制度及知识形式。语言和地方经历的多样性，使“玛雅”成为相互联系的文化世界，而不是可以指定一个中古终结年份的人群。

《波波尔·乌》保存特定基切人的叙述，今日口头与书面创作则提供考古纪念物不能独自呈现的立场。社群语言教学及政治权利诉求，同早期王室铭文属于同一历史领域，却不是完全相同的制度。里戈韦塔·门楚的公共倡议连接现代土地、暴力与代表权历史。延续包含适应与分歧，并非从古代起冻结不变。

title.en: Chinampas: building farmland within a lake
title.zh: 奇南帕：在湖泊中营造农田

location.label: Xochimilco; representative farming landscape

summary.en:
Chinampas are cultivated plots constructed within a lake landscape and separated by channels. Farmers assembled and maintained soils, water access and boundaries in ways that supported intensive production near urban consumers. The system joined technical knowledge to organized labour, transport and household livelihoods. The surviving Xochimilco landscape preserves part of an agricultural history that predates the Spanish conquest.

Farming continued through changes in political authority, crops and markets. Urban expansion and damaged water systems later brought new pressures, while farmers adapted production and transmitted knowledge across generations. Calling the plots floating gardens can obscure the work required to build and maintain fields. Their history connects the food needs of the Mexica capital with continuing agriculture near modern Mexico City; neither monumental architecture nor a dynasty list alone explains how cities were fed.
summary.zh:
奇南帕是在湖泊景观中营建、由水道分隔的耕作地块。农民维护土壤、水源和田界，在城市消费者附近进行集约生产。该制度把技术知识同组织劳动、交通及家庭生计相连。今日索奇米尔科景观保留了西班牙征服以前农业史的一部分。

政治权威、作物与市场改变后，农耕仍在继续。城市扩张和水系统受损带来新压力，农民也调整生产并跨代传授知识。把地块称为“浮动花园”，可能掩盖营建及维护农田的劳动。它们的历史把墨西加都城的食物需求同今日墨西哥城附近农业联系起来；单靠纪念性建筑或王朝列表，无法说明城市如何获得食物。

title.en: Popol Vuh: preserving a K’iche’ account across scripts
title.zh: 《波波尔·乌》：跨文字保存基切叙述

location.label: Chichicastenango / K’iche’ highlands; representative manuscript setting

summary.en:
K’iche’ authors used alphabetic writing after the conquest to preserve accounts of creation, ancestral events and ruling lineages. The work known as the Popol Vuh joined older knowledge to a medium taught under colonial conditions. It was not a European story merely translated into a Maya language, nor an untouched transcript outside the changes imposed by conquest.

Scholarly examination places the lost sixteenth-century text around 1554–1558. The surviving manuscript copied by Francisco Ximénez between about 1700 and 1715 includes K’iche’ and Spanish, adding another stage of selection and interpretation. The Newberry Library’s manuscript and modern scholarship make these layers visible. Reading the work requires attention to authors, copyists, translators and living K’iche’ understandings. Its preservation shows how people could use introduced literacy to sustain histories that colonial power threatened to marginalize.
summary.zh:
征服后，基切作者运用字母书写，保存创世、祖先事件与统治谱系叙述。《波波尔·乌》把较早知识同殖民条件下传授的文字媒介结合。它既不是把欧洲故事翻成玛雅语言，也不是不受征服影响、原封不动的记录。

研究把失传的十六世纪文本推定于约1554—1558年。弗朗西斯科·希梅内斯约1700—1715年抄写的现存手稿，包含基切文与西班牙文，增加另一层选择与解释。纽伯里图书馆手稿和现代研究揭示这些层次。阅读时应关注作者、抄写者、译者及基切人的活态理解。其保存说明，人们可以运用传入的识字方式，延续殖民权力可能使之边缘化的历史。

dateNote.en: 1554–1558 is a scholarly reconstruction for the earlier text; surviving copy c.1700–1715.

title.en: Chavín: pilgrimage, stone and ritual authority
title.zh: 查文：朝圣、石刻与仪式权威

location.label: Chavín de Huántar; ceremonial center

summary.en:
Chavín de Huántar brought monumental architecture, stone imagery and controlled interior spaces together in an Andean religious center. Plazas and terraces organized gatherings while galleries, vents and drains created environments experienced differently from open public space. Animal and human forms combined in carved images whose meanings were embedded in ritual knowledge.

Pilgrimage and the circulation of images connected people across ecological and linguistic boundaries. Similar objects or motifs found elsewhere do not automatically mark conquered provinces of a Chavín empire. Archaeological research instead investigates how ritual specialists could build authority through architecture, access and performance. The site offers an early comparison with later Andean centers where political power and sacred landscapes were also linked. Its preserved buildings are evidence for changes over time, not the remains of one plan constructed in a single founding year.
summary.zh:
查文德万塔尔把纪念性建筑、石刻图像和受控内部空间，结合为安第斯宗教中心。广场与台地组织集会，回廊、通风口和排水设施则营造不同于开放场地的体验。动物与人类形象在石刻中结合，其意义嵌入仪式知识。

朝圣与图像流通把不同生态、语言背景的人连接起来。其他地方发现相似物品或纹样，并不自动表示它们是查文帝国征服的省份。考古研究探讨仪式专家如何借建筑、通行控制和表演建立权威。该遗址可与后来同样连接政治力量及神圣景观的安第斯中心比较。保存建筑反映历时变化，并非某个建城年份一次完成的统一计划。

title.en: Moche: courts, craft and northern coastal societies
title.zh: 莫切：宫廷、工艺与北部海岸社会

location.label: Moche valley; representative north-coast center

summary.en:
Moche societies on Peru’s northern coast supported monumental centers and workshops whose products made authority visible. Ceramics show rulers, warriors, plants, animals and ritual scenes, while metalworkers developed methods for shaping and treating gold, silver and copper. These objects connect skilled labour to elite display and religious practice.

Moche is an archaeological and artistic designation, not proof that every valley belonged to one centralized empire. Different centers and changing relationships require local evidence. Decorated vessels could be used, repaired and finally placed in burials, giving them biographies beyond a single ceremonial moment. Comparing ceramics with archaeological contexts helps avoid treating every painted scene as a literal picture of daily life. The later Sicán and Chimú worlds inherited and transformed some northern coastal practices, while the Inca eventually encountered societies with long histories of their own.
summary.zh:
秘鲁北部海岸的莫切社会拥有纪念性中心与工坊，其产品使权威可见。陶器描绘统治者、武士、动植物和仪式；金工发展塑造及处理金、银、铜的方法。这些物品把熟练劳动同精英展示和宗教实践联系起来。

“莫切”是考古与艺术分类，并不能证明每个河谷属于同一中央集权帝国。不同中心及变化中的关系，需要地方证据。彩绘器皿可能先被使用、修补，最后进入墓葬，拥有超出单次仪式的物品生命史。结合陶器与出土环境，可避免把每幅图像当作日常生活的直接照片。后来的西坎与奇穆世界继承并改变部分北岸实践，印加后来面对的是已有长久历史的社会。

title.en: Paracas textiles: labour, bodies and the afterlife
title.zh: 帕拉卡斯纺织：劳动、身体与来世

location.label: Paracas Peninsula; representative burial landscape

summary.en:
Textiles from the Paracas Peninsula preserve evidence of skilled work that rarely survives in other environments. Embroiderers organized repeated figures, contrasting colours and intricate structures into garments and borders. Animals, plants, ceremonial performers and supernatural forms carried meanings through the way cloth covered and presented a body.

Many surviving examples came from burials where the dead were wrapped in multiple layers with food and other belongings. The dry coastal environment helped preserve this material, making the archaeological sample unusually rich but also selective. Elite funerary cloth does not describe every person’s wardrobe. Studying spinning, weaving, embroidery and burial placement restores labour and bodily practice to an account otherwise dominated by monumental buildings. Connections with other coastal communities concern circulation and changing techniques, not an automatic sequence in which one culture disappeared the instant another appeared.
summary.zh:
帕拉卡斯半岛的纺织品保存了在其他环境中少见的熟练劳动证据。绣工把重复人物、对比色彩和复杂结构组合为衣物及边饰。动物、植物、仪式表演者和超自然形象，通过布料覆盖及呈现身体的方式传递意义。

许多遗存来自墓葬：死者被多层布料包裹，并伴随食物和其他物品。干燥海岸有助保存，使样本丰富却也具有选择性。精英丧葬织物不能代表所有人的衣着。研究纺纱、织造、刺绣和安置方式，可把劳动及身体实践重新纳入常由纪念性建筑主导的叙述。与其他海岸社群的联系涉及流通和技术变化，并非一种文化出现时另一种便瞬间消失。

title.en: Andean farming: crops and herds across altitudes
title.zh: 安第斯农耕：不同海拔的作物与畜群

location.label: Cusco–Puno corridor; representative highland landscape

summary.en:
Andean farmers worked within steep environmental contrasts rather than a single uniform agricultural zone. Terraces, irrigation and raised fields helped communities manage water and cultivable land, while crops and herds suited different elevations. Potatoes, quinoa and camelids belonged to systems of knowledge and selection accumulated over generations.

The Inca expanded existing practices and drew labour and produce into wider political arrangements; they did not invent every technique used within their empire. Contemporary agricultural heritage preserves evidence of continuing knowledge, but it cannot by itself date every ancient field. Comparing living practice with archaeology allows continuity to be discussed without assuming that nothing changed. Food production connected households to ceremonial centers, roads and state demands. Those relationships make agriculture part of political history as well as a background activity outside the story of rulers.
summary.zh:
安第斯农民面对的是陡峭的环境差异，而非单一均质农区。梯田、灌溉与高畦田帮助社群管理水和耕地，作物与畜群则适应不同海拔。马铃薯、藜麦及骆驼科家畜，属于跨代积累的知识和选育体系。

印加扩展已有实践，并把劳动和产品纳入更广政治安排，并非发明帝国内全部技术。今日农业遗产保存持续知识的证据，却不能单独确定每块古田的年代。结合活态实践与考古，才能讨论延续而不假设从未变化。食物生产把家庭同仪式中心、道路及国家索求相连，使农业也是政治史的一部分，而不是统治者故事之外的背景劳动。

title.en: Inka quipu: counting labour and resources
title.zh: 印加结绳：记录劳动与资源

location.label: Cusco; representative administrative reference

summary.en:
Quipu, or khipu, used cords and knots to organize information in the Inka world. Colours, positions and types of knots could distinguish categories and numerical values. Specialists known as quipucamayocs managed records needed for populations, production and labour obligations. Recording was therefore part of how administration mobilized people and goods, not simply a mathematical curiosity.

Surviving examples demonstrate numerical organization, while the range of information encoded and the possibilities of non-numerical recording remain subjects of research. Claims that all quipu have been deciphered exceed the evidence. The system connected material practice, trained memory and institutional work in a society that did not rely on an alphabetic bureaucracy like Spain’s. Comparing it with manuscripts elsewhere reveals several ways to preserve knowledge without ranking peoples by whether their records resemble European books.
summary.zh:
结绳 quipu 或 khipu 运用绳索和绳结组织印加世界的信息。颜色、位置与结型可以区分类别和数值。称为 quipucamayoc 的专家，管理人口、生产和劳动义务记录。因此，记录是行政调动人与物的方式，不只是数学奇观。

遗存证明其数值组织功能，但信息范围及非数值记录的可能性仍是研究问题，不能声称全部结绳已经被解读。这个体系把材料实践、训练记忆与机构劳动相连，不依赖西班牙式字母官僚文书。同其他地区手稿比较，可以看到保存知识的多种方式，而不以记录是否像欧洲书籍来给民族排序。

dateNote.en: Focus c.1400–1532 on Inka administration; this does not date the earliest or latest use of knotted records.

title.en: Andes, 1532–1572: conquest and continuing resistance
title.zh: 1532—1572年安第斯：征服与持续抵抗

location.label: Cusco; representative contested political center

summary.en:
Spanish intervention entered an Andean world already divided by a struggle over Inca succession. Pizarro’s forces captured Atahualpa at Cajamarca in 1532 and executed him the following year despite the delivery of a ransom. Spanish power depended not only on European weapons but also on Indigenous alliances and conflicts within the existing imperial order.

The occupation of royal centers did not end resistance. Inca successor rulers maintained a refuge in the Vilcabamba region while colonial institutions, tribute and religious conversion transformed other areas. The execution of Túpac Amaru I in 1572 marks a political endpoint for that royal resistance, not the disappearance of Andean peoples. Indigenous craftsmen and writers continued to create works under changed patronage. Later testimony, including Guaman Poma’s chronicle, exposes the violence and negotiations concealed by a narrative of effortless imperial replacement.
summary.zh:
西班牙人进入安第斯时，印加继承权斗争已经造成分裂。皮萨罗部队于1532年在卡哈马卡俘获阿塔瓦尔帕；尽管赎金交付，仍于次年将其处死。西班牙权力不仅依靠欧洲武器，也依赖原住民联盟和既有帝国内部冲突。

占领王室中心没有终止抵抗。印加继承统治者在比尔卡班巴地区维持据点，其他地方则被殖民机构、贡赋和宗教改造改变。1572年图帕克·阿马鲁一世被处决，标志这一王室抵抗的政治终点，而非安第斯民族消失。原住民工匠和作者在新资助关系下继续创作。关曼·波马等人的见证揭示暴力与协商，反驳帝国毫不费力地彼此替换的叙述。

title.en: Lambayeque/Sicán: metal, status and skilled work
title.zh: 兰巴耶克／西坎：金属、地位与熟练劳动

location.label: Batán Grande region; representative north-coast reference

summary.en:
Lambayeque, also called Sicán, artists on Peru’s north coast made metal vessels, masks and ornaments that connected skilled production with elite display. Thin sheets could be hammered into shapes and patterned from both sides. The composition and surface of an object mattered alongside its form: a gleaming appearance was itself part of how materials communicated status and ritual significance.

A gold funerary mask dated to the ninth–eleventh centuries provides one anchor for this record, while related vessels reveal different techniques and possible uses. Objects removed from archaeological settings cannot always be assigned a complete original biography. Their study nonetheless broadens the regional sequence between Moche and Chimú beyond the names of rulers. Mining, alloying, forming and ceremonial consumption depended on many kinds of labour that an imperial succession chart leaves invisible.
summary.zh:
秘鲁北岸的兰巴耶克——亦称西坎——艺术家制作金属器皿、面具和饰品，把熟练生产与精英展示连接起来。薄金属片可被锤打成形，并从正反两面制作纹样。材质组成、表面与形状同样重要：闪耀外观也是材料传达地位及仪式意义的方式。

一件定为九至十一世纪的黄金葬仪面具，为本条提供年代锚点；相关器皿展示不同技术与可能用途。离开出土环境的物品，未必能够复原完整来历，但它们仍使莫切至奇穆之间的区域序列超出统治者名字。采矿、配合金、成形和仪式消费，依赖帝国更替表中看不见的多种劳动。

title.en: Kuélap: architecture in the Andean cloud forest
title.zh: 库埃拉普：安第斯云雾林中的建筑

location.label: Kuélap; monumental archaeological complex

summary.en:
Kuélap stands in the eastern Andean cloud-forest region associated with Chachapoya societies. Its large platform and circular buildings required planning, material transport and organized labour over generations. Residential, ceremonial and funerary features show that the complex cannot be explained simply as a military wall or a remote imitation of Inca architecture.

Relationships among the Utcubamba valley’s settlements remain subjects of interpretation. Peru’s tentative World Heritage submission proposes regional political connections, but nomination language is not proof of one precisely bounded Chachapoya state. Inca expansion and colonial resettlement changed the landscape without erasing every local tradition. The monumental site provides an eastern-Andean counterpart to coastal and highland centers elsewhere in the atlas. Its buildings make the labour and environmental setting of regional histories visible alongside later imperial incorporation.
summary.zh:
库埃拉普位于与查查波亚社会有关的安第斯东部云雾林地区。大型台基与圆形建筑，需要数代人的规划、材料运输和组织劳动。居住、仪式及丧葬设施说明，不能只把它理解为军事城墙，或偏远地区对印加建筑的模仿。

乌特库班巴河谷各聚落的关系仍有不同解释。秘鲁的世界遗产预备名单申请提出区域政治联系，但申报措辞不能证明存在边界精确的单一查查波亚国家。印加扩张与殖民集中安置改变景观，却没有抹去全部地方传统。该遗址为图集中其他海岸与高地中心提供安第斯东部对照，展示帝国纳入之前区域史的劳动和环境基础。

title.en: Chankillo: reading the year along the horizon
title.zh: 昌基略：沿地平线读取一年

location.label: Chankillo; solar-observation complex

summary.en:
Thirteen towers on a ridge at Chankillo created an artificial horizon for observing the Sun’s changing position through the year. From designated viewing points, the sequence could mark dates rather than only a single annual event. The towers belonged to a wider complex of ceremonial and administrative buildings within the Casma Valley’s desert landscape.

Archaeological and astronomical research interprets the arrangement as evidence for organized timekeeping centuries before the Inca. A calendar can coordinate labour, ritual and authority, though the identity and institutions of the builders cannot all be reconstructed from the towers alone. The site’s relatively brief period of use also warns against extending its function unchanged across millennia. Chankillo provides a concrete comparison with calendars and observatories elsewhere without implying that all societies followed the same path toward one universal scientific tradition.
summary.zh:
昌基略山脊上的十三座塔，构成人工地平线，用来观察太阳在一年中位置的变化。从特定观测点，塔列能够标识日期，而不仅是一年中的单一事件。它们属于卡斯马河谷沙漠景观中更广的仪式及行政建筑群。

考古与天文学研究把这一布局解释为印加之前数百年有组织计时的证据。历法能够协调劳动、仪式和权威，但仅凭塔列无法重建建造者的全部身份与制度。遗址使用期相对短暂，也提醒人们不能把功能原样延伸数千年。昌基略可同其他地区历法与观象设施比较，却不意味着所有社会都沿相同路径走向单一普遍科学传统。

title.en: Lake Titicaca: raised fields and collective landscapes
title.zh: 的的喀喀湖：高畦田与集体景观

location.label: Lake Titicaca basin; representative agricultural landscape

summary.en:
Raised-field farming reorganized low-lying ground around Lake Titicaca into cultivated surfaces separated by channels. Constructing and maintaining these landscapes required knowledge of soils and water, repeated labour and coordination among cultivators. Agricultural production helped sustain settlements in a high-altitude environment, while different communities developed their own arrangements for work and access.

Archaeologists debate the relationship between field systems, local organization and states such as Tiwanaku. The existence of extensive earthworks does not automatically prove that a central ruler designed or controlled every field. Research comparing settlements and farming landscapes therefore matters as much as monumental temples. Later abandonment, reuse and present-day agricultural heritage add further layers. The history makes food production and the organization of labour visible alongside the political and ritual centers that depended on cultivated land.
summary.zh:
的的喀喀湖周边低地的高畦田，把可耕面同沟渠交错组织。营建与维护需要土壤及水的知识、反复劳动，以及耕作者之间的协调。农业支撑高海拔环境中的聚落，不同社群也发展自己的劳动和使用安排。

考古学家讨论田系、地方组织与蒂瓦纳科等国家之间的关系。大规模土方并不自动证明中央统治者设计或控制每块田，因此比较聚落和农业景观，与研究纪念性神庙同样重要。后来的废弃、再用及今日农业遗产，增加新的历史层次。这段历史让食物生产与劳动组织，同依赖耕地的政治和仪式中心并列可见。

title.en: Cusco: organizing a sacred and administrative capital
title.zh: 库斯科：组织神圣与行政都城

location.label: Cusco / Qorikancha vicinity; representative urban center

summary.en:
Cusco’s development under Pachacuti connected royal authority with an ordered urban landscape. Religious and administrative functions occupied defined spaces, while surrounding areas supported agriculture and craft production. The city was not only a court residence: its built environment organized relationships among rulers, sacred institutions, workers and people incorporated into an expanding imperial system.

Inca masonry, roads and the sacred center later existed beneath and beside colonial construction. Spanish churches and houses reused parts of the older urban structure while imposing new forms of authority and worship. The Qorikancha’s transformation is one example of this layered history. Archaeology and surviving buildings permit comparisons between imperial organization and the colonial city, but modern property boundaries cannot be projected backward as a map of fifteenth-century political control. Cusco continued as a living city beyond the end of independent Inca rule.
summary.zh:
帕查库蒂时期库斯科的发展，把王室权威同有秩序的城市景观连接起来。宗教与行政功能占据特定空间，周边地区承担农业和工艺生产。城市不只是宫廷住处；建筑环境组织统治者、神圣机构、劳动者及被纳入扩张帝国者之间的关系。

印加石工、道路与神圣中心，后来存在于殖民建筑之下和旁侧。西班牙教堂与住宅利用旧有城市结构的一部分，同时施加新的权威和崇拜形式。太阳神庙科里坎查的转变就是例子。考古和现存建筑可供比较帝国组织与殖民城市，但不能把今日地界倒推成十五世纪政治控制图。独立印加统治终结后，库斯科仍是活着的城市。

dateNote.en: Focus c.1438–1532 on imperial urban organization; city foundations are older and the city continues.
dateNote.zh: 关注约1438—1532年的帝国城市组织；建城更早，城市也延续至今。

title.en: Encomienda and the limits of colonial reform
title.zh: 监护征赋制与殖民改革的限度

location.label: Guatemalan highlands; representative colonial setting

summary.en:
Encomienda gave Spanish beneficiaries claims on Indigenous tribute and labour while presenting Christian instruction and protection as obligations. It was not simply ownership of a parcel of land. The arrangement attached colonial power to existing communities and authorities, drawing household production into demands imposed by conquerors and officials.

The New Laws of 1542 attempted to restrain abuses and Indigenous enslavement, but proclamation did not equal enforcement. Resistance by colonists, legal exceptions and continuing coercive practices limited reform. Indigenous people petitioned and negotiated within colonial institutions while also resisting outside them. Recent research challenges the older narrative that a royal decree cleanly ended Native slavery. Reading the legislation beside local histories makes the distance between stated protection and lived exploitation visible, and helps explain why sixteenth-century K’iche’ authors preserved genealogies and historical claims in alphabetic texts.
summary.zh:
监护征赋制使西班牙受益人获得向原住民索取贡赋及劳动的主张，并把基督教教化和保护作为其义务。它不简单等于拥有一块土地，而是把殖民权力附着于既有社群和权威，把家庭生产纳入征服者与官员的索求。

1542年新法试图限制虐待和对原住民的奴役，但颁布不等于落实。殖民者反对、法律例外及持续胁迫，限制改革效果。原住民在殖民机构内请愿和协商，也在其外抵抗。新研究挑战一道王令便彻底终结原住民奴隶制的旧叙述。结合法令与地方史，可见宣称保护和实际剥削的距离，也有助理解基切作者为何以字母文本保存谱系与历史主张。

dateNote.en: Editorial sixteenth-century focus; 1542 is a reform milestone, not a universal end of coercive labour or encomienda.
dateNote.zh: 编辑关注十六世纪；1542年是改革节点，不是强迫劳动或监护征赋制普遍终结的年份。

title.en: Palmares: building freedom under siege
title.zh: 帕尔马雷斯：围攻下建立自由

location.label: Serra da Barriga; representative Palmares landscape

summary.en:
Palmares brought together settlements formed by people resisting slavery in northeastern Brazil. Food production, defense and relations with the surrounding colonial economy supported communities that could not survive through escape alone. The settlements created social and political arrangements in a landscape repeatedly targeted by colonial expeditions.

The history includes negotiation and disagreement as well as military resistance. The destruction of the major fortified center in 1694 did not end every fugitive community or the wider history of quilombos. Later remembrance made Palmares and Zumbi symbols in struggles over freedom and Afro-Brazilian identity. Historical reconstruction relies heavily on documents written by enemies, so numbers, leadership narratives and territorial claims require caution. The surviving landscape should not be turned into a precise national border drawn from commemorative descriptions.
summary.zh:
帕尔马雷斯由巴西东北部抵抗奴隶制者建立的多个聚落组成。食物生产、防御及同周边殖民经济的关系，支持这些不能只靠逃亡维生的社群。面对殖民远征反复攻击，聚落建立自己的社会和政治安排。

历史既包含军事抵抗，也包含协商与分歧。1694年主要设防中心被毁，没有终结全部逃奴社群或更广的 quilombo 历史。后来的记忆使帕尔马雷斯与祖比，成为自由和非裔巴西认同斗争的象征。重建依赖大量敌方文书，因此人数、领袖叙述和领土主张需要谨慎。不能依据纪念性描述，把遗址景观画成边界精确的民族国家。

title.en: Suriname Maroons: treaties won through resistance
title.zh: 苏里南逃奴社群：以抵抗争得的条约

location.label: Tapanahony region; representative Ndyuka community reference

summary.en:
People who escaped plantation slavery in Suriname formed communities in the interior and defended their freedom against colonial forces. Treaties with the Ndyuka in 1760, Saamaka in 1762 and Matawai in 1767 recognized freedoms that resistance had made impossible for the colonial government simply to ignore. The agreements also imposed conditions on residence, trade and relations with plantations.

Maroons understood the treaties as the basis of enduring relationships, not temporary permission to exist. Their histories include agriculture, kinship, leadership and spiritual life as well as fighting. Museum accounts from the communities and later land-rights documentation show how the meaning of the agreements persisted after Dutch colonial rule. The treaties therefore belong to political history alongside European diplomatic settlements, while each people’s institutions and interpretation require distinct attention rather than a single generic category of escaped slaves.
summary.zh:
苏里南种植园的逃亡者在内陆建立社群，抵抗殖民军以保卫自由。殖民政府分别于1760年与恩久卡、1762年与萨马卡、1767年与马塔瓦伊签约，承认抵抗已使其无法忽视的自由。协议同时对居住、贸易及同种植园的关系施加条件。

逃奴社群把条约视为持续关系的基础，而非暂时获准存在。他们的历史包括农业、亲属、领导及精神生活，不只有战斗。社群博物馆叙述与后来的土地权利文献，显示协议意义如何延续于荷兰殖民统治之后。因此，这些条约应同欧洲外交安排并列纳入政治史，同时分别关注各族制度与解释，而非统一归入无差别的“逃奴”类别。

title.en: Caribbean sugar: plantations, skill and coercion
title.zh: 加勒比蔗糖：种植园、技能与强制

location.label: Barbados; representative plantation island, not the whole Atlantic system

summary.en:
Sugar production tied Caribbean land and water to coerced African labour and Atlantic markets. Plantation work involved more than cutting cane: mills, boiling houses, transport and provisioning demanded coordinated tasks, many requiring experience and skill. Enslaved people faced long hours, dangerous machinery and punishment within an institution that treated human beings as property.

The plantation combined field agriculture with concentrated processing, making labour discipline and the timing of harvest central to profit. Households, food cultivation, cultural practices and resistance formed part of enslaved people’s lives despite the coercive order. Museum and archaeological interpretation can recover traces beyond account books written by owners. Comparing sugar with mining at Potosí and cotton economies elsewhere reveals connected systems of exploitation without assuming that every colony, crop or labour regime was identical.
summary.zh:
蔗糖生产把加勒比的土地和水，同被强制劳动的非洲人及大西洋市场连接起来。种植园劳动不只是砍甘蔗：磨坊、煮糖房、运输与给养需要协调，其中许多任务依靠经验和技能。奴隶制把人当作财产，人们承受长工时、危险机械及惩罚。

种植园结合田间农业和集中加工，使劳动纪律及收获时机成为利润关键。家庭、食物栽培、文化实践与抵抗，仍存在于受奴役者的生活中。博物馆及考古解释能发现园主账本之外的痕迹。把蔗糖同波托西采矿和其他棉业经济比较，可见彼此联系的剥削体系，而不假设每个殖民地、作物和劳动制度完全相同。

dateNote.zh: 编辑关注约1650—1800年；不把两端定为加勒比奴隶制的开始或废除日期。

title.en: Argentina, 1983: elections after dictatorship
title.zh: 1983年阿根廷：独裁之后的选举

location.label: Buenos Aires; representative national political center

summary.en:
Argentina’s October 1983 election followed more than seven years of military dictatorship. Raúl Alfonsín’s victory and December inauguration restored an elected civilian presidency after repression, disappearances and the disruption of constitutional government. Returning to elections was a political achievement made possible by pressures within society and the weakening of military authority.

An electoral result did not by itself resolve how to investigate state violence, account for the disappeared or prevent future military intervention. Democracy required institutions and continuing public participation as well as a change of officeholders. Official election records provide a precise anchor, while commemorations emphasize the meaning of restored participation. Placing these sources together distinguishes the event of voting from the longer struggle to build civilian authority and confront the legacies of dictatorship.
summary.zh:
1983年10月阿根廷选举，发生在七年多军事独裁之后。劳尔·阿方辛获胜并于12月就职，在镇压、失踪及宪制破坏后恢复民选文职总统。重返选举是社会压力与军方权威削弱促成的政治成就。

一次选举结果，不能单独解决如何调查国家暴力、追寻失踪者或防止军方再次干政。民主需要制度与持续公众参与，不只是换一批任职者。官方选举档案提供精确节点，纪念叙述则强调恢复参与的意义。结合这些资料，可区分投票事件与建立文职权威、面对独裁遗产的长期斗争。

title.en: Chile, 1973–1990: military dictatorship and opposition
title.zh: 1973—1990年智利：军事独裁与反对运动

location.label: Santiago; representative national political center

summary.en:
Chile’s armed forces overthrew Salvador Allende’s government on 11 September 1973. Augusto Pinochet became the central figure in a dictatorship that suppressed political opposition and violated human rights. Censorship and control of institutions altered how people could speak, organize and obtain information, while economic restructuring changed employment and social provision.

Resistance took many forms, including clandestine publications, human-rights work, women’s organizing and public protest. The National Library’s collections of pamphlets make these activities visible beyond accounts centered on military leaders. The 1988 plebiscite and the return to civilian government in 1990 belong to the transition, but the consequences of dictatorship continued in institutions and public memory. A political period on the timeline marks a governing order, not agreement among Chileans about its meaning or a complete explanation of every social change.
summary.zh:
1973年9月11日，智利军队推翻萨尔瓦多·阿连德政府。奥古斯托·皮诺切特成为独裁核心人物，镇压政治反对者并侵犯人权。审查和机构控制改变人们发言、组织与获取信息的方式，经济重组则改变就业及社会保障。

抵抗形式多样，包括地下出版、人权工作、妇女组织及公开抗议。国家图书馆的小册子收藏，使这些活动超出军事领袖中心的叙述而可见。1988年公民投票和1990年文职政府恢复属于转型过程，独裁后果却继续存在于制度和公共记忆。时间线上的政治阶段表示一种统治秩序，不代表智利人对其意义取得共识，也不能完全解释所有社会变化。
